profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Apple | Apple Services Engineering
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in Management, Test Planning, C#, Front-end Development, and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Applied Science (B.A.Sc.) focused in Computer Science from University of Virginia.
